triggers: Forensic audit ordered by SEBI or Ministry of Corporate Affairs (MCA)
Credit rating downgrade by 2 or more notches or into speculative grade
Promoter share pledging exceeding 30% of promoter holding
Quarterly net profit decline > 35% YoY without prior management guidance
Default on commercial paper, bond coupon, or bank loan covenants
critical_severity.recommended_investor_action: Review for immediate exit / capital preservation

triggers: CEO / Managing Director / CFO resignation or abrupt termination
Tax demand or legal claim exceeding 5% of net worth
Inclusion in SEBI Additional Surveillance Measure (ASM) or Graded Surveillance Measure (GSM)
Daily closing price breaks below 200 EMA with 2x average volume (Positional trades)
Star Mutual Fund Manager departure from active portfolio
Mutual Fund category AUM ballooning causing cash drag > 12%
Quarterly EBITDA margin contraction > 200 bps due to input cost pressures
Government policy shift: unexpected export duty, windfall tax, or tariff reduction
Promoter stake dilution in open market > 2%
Technical breakdown below 50 EMA on daily chart (Short-term swing holdings)
Mutual Fund expense ratio increase > 15 bps
